name: The Hungry Cart
place: dungeon mine_descent SET B: the boss cavern of the last floor (28 m square)
_doc: Stream E (M2). An ore cart that ate the last shift and liked it. Two sets of rails cross the cavern: RUNAWAY CARTS come down them as long lines along the fixed rails (the rails are where you must not stand). The rail switch (lever) sends one cart into the boss, once. P1 'Ore Rush': a coin-spray cone, runaway carts, ore lumps tossed to random players. P2 at 60% 'Lights Out': it snuffs the three mine lanterns and shelters in darkness (a shield) while rats swarm; relight the lanterns to crack it. P3 is a new health bar 'Feeding Time': a gulp that must be SOAKED by two players, a stack, carts on both rails at once, and a ring of thrown teeth.
party: Solo: rails are learnable; the two-player gulp soak will fail — survivable with a follower. 2-3: intended. 5: easy soaks; carts hit crowds. M5 scaling: gulp need = min(2, party); rat adds 4 -> 2 solo.

onUse.say: The switch clanks over — a loaded cart smashes into the Hungry Cart!

pull: A cart at the end of the rails creaks. Its lid lifts. There are teeth under the lid.
Clank. Clank. Clank. Something rolls toward you, licking its rim.
say.death: The Hungry Cart tips over and spills out a small fortune in ore, boots, and one helmet.
say.reset: The cart rolls back to the end of the line and pretends to be a cart.

enrage.say: The Hungry Cart's lid flaps open wide enough to swallow everyone!

runaway_east.name: Runaway Cart
runaway_east.say: A cart comes screaming down the east rails — off the tracks!

runaway_north.name: Runaway Cart
runaway_north.say: Another cart on the north line — move!

rat_swarm.name: Rat Swarm
rat_swarm.say: Rats pour out of the cart's belly!

gulp.name: Gulp
gulp.say: The cart opens wide near {target} — two of you stand in its mouth or it eats the room!

telegraphs.failSay: Nobody filled its mouth — the cart inhales and everything gets bitten!

share_the_load.name: Heavy Load
share_the_load.say: {target} is buried under ore — three of you, dig them out together!

teeth.name: Thrown Teeth
teeth.say: Teeth fly in a ring — get in close!

phases.name: Lights Out
phases.say: The cart snaps its lid at the lanterns. Darkness.

onEnter.say: The Hungry Cart hides in the dark. Light all three mine lanterns!

phases.name: Feeding Time
phases.say: The cart rears up on its back wheels. It is very, very hungry.

do.say: Three lanterns burn! The cart is dazzled and rolls out of the dark!
